reasons: Red: AI basket drawdown / momentum, Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.87% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +19bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.6pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 14bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 140 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 98 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 18.1 sits at the 63th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 12.0, so implied carries +6.1 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: CoreWeave sweetens terms on $2.6B loan tied to Anthropic, Jane Street and Hudson River Trading capacity as investors balk at AI debt; CoreWeave's 5-year CDS up over 50% this month
items.note: A neocloud having to widen pricing (+up to 125bps) and deepen the discount (99c to 97c) to clear a loan is a direct market read on deteriorating AI-debt appetite, not commentary.

items.headline: Meta's free cash flow collapses 91% YoY to $784M as AI investment consumes 98% of operating cash flow; shares fall ~9% on a disappointing revenue outlook
items.note: Near-total consumption of operating cash by AI capex is a credit-relevant cash-generation signal distinct from the stock move itself, and raises the odds Meta leans further on debt to fund its build-out.

items.headline: Alphabet raises 2026 capex guidance to as much as $205B and posts its first negative free cash flow since its 2004 IPO; shares fall ~7%
items.note: A hyperscaler burning cash for the first time in its public history while raising capex guidance above analyst expectations sharpens the question of how the AI buildout gets financed if internally generated cash no longer covers it.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
